one_line: A suspicious walkie-talkie item that instantly grants its user an antagonist role (or refunds premium currency if they can't be one), alongside the 'All-American' diner ghost-role spawners and the round-end credit/XP reward payout logic.
player_facing_mechanics: Use a 'suspicious station bounced radio' (antag_maker) in hand to become an antagonist (traitor/heretic/brother/changeling/bloodsucker/spy/wizard/nukie/clown op depending on subtype)
If you already have an antag datum when using the radio, you are refunded metacoins (Doubloons) instead of gaining a role
If your assigned role is not antag-tokenable, you are refunded metacoins and cannot become the antag
The radio self-deletes (qdel) after one use and has a has_used exploit guard
Some antag_maker variants force-drop all your gear and paralyze you for 30 seconds before handing out the role (force_drop_equipment flag)
Ghost role: spawn as the All-American Chef via a sleeper pod, leading the kitchen (spawner_job /datum/job/ghostchef, outfit ghostchef)
Ghost role: spawn as the All-American Cook, subordinate to the chef
Ghost role: spawn as the All-American Regular, a stranded customer/fake health inspector carrying a briefcase
Chef spawner, on Destroy, drops a Cook spawner at its location (props propagate)
At round end, each player earns 100 Doubloons for 'Played a Round' and 25 for a desired Command/Security/Silicon role
Antagonists earn extra credit rewards for each completed objective (objective reward_for_completion / completion_credit_reward) plus a 100 Doubloon Greentext Bonus if all objectives complete
A station-goal completion bonus pays every joined player (pop >= 10) an equal share, 10 credits per crew capped at 500
Rewards are announced in chat and deposited via adjust_metacoins (no announcement for the bulk deposit)

port_notes: The antag_maker is straightforward to port as an entity with a component that, on use (interact/UseInHand or DoAfter), adds a role to the user's mind through SS14's role/gamerule-antagonist system rather than a BYOND antag datum; the refund-on-existing-antag and tokenable-role checks become system queries against the player's current roles. Ghost roles map cleanly to SS14 GhostRoleSpawnerComponent plus ghost-role jobs and loadouts (outfits -> startingGear/prototypes). The roundend reward proc has no direct analogue and would need a new round-end gamerule/system that iterates connected players, inspects their roles/objectives, and pays currency via an economy system. A human must decide how to model the persistent Doubloon/metacoin economy, whether objectives track completion credit in SS14's ObjectiveSystem, and whether the antag_maker should remain a consumable item or be replaced by an admin/dynamic-ruleset path.
